outcomes.title: What PDR Kalk Does for You

cards.heading: Hail Damage Estimates
bullets: Automatic AW logic using the latest insurance matrices
Choose between private and business customers directly from your address book
All important fields clearly displayed on one page
Instant live calculation while entering damage
Add R&R (removal & refitting) and custom notes to reports
Each job is saved locally with automatic backup
Any deviation from insurance matrices is clearly displayed for insurers, building transparency and trust

cards.heading: Parking Dent Estimates
bullets: Fast and intuitive parking dent calculator
Select customer from address book
Choose pricing per vehicle or per panel
One-click surcharges for: dent size, material type, deep dents, stretched dents, body line dents, creases
You control the pricing — the system handles the text, descriptions and formatting
Add photos and generate the PDF instantly

cards.heading: Save 30–60 Minutes Per Job
bullets: Lightning-fast damage capture
Office work reduced by 30–60 minutes per job
Photos automatically compressed and embedded
Creates a single PDF for customer or insurance, with or without discounts

cards.heading: Full Control of Your Data
bullets: Stored locally on your computer
Works completely offline — no internet required
Automatic job backups and full-system backup options
Ideal for hail technicians and mobile parking dent specialists

cards.heading: From Estimate to Invoice
bullets: Create professional invoices in seconds
Single-job or multi-job invoice creation
Formatted for standard C5 window envelopes

Custom introduction and closing texts
